title: Connect Link Pannu Win Pannu
description: Actors from Vijay TV serials, playing mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law, take on lively rounds with smart clues and fast answers. The Chase round keeps the outcome suspenseful.

title: Neeya Naana
description: Gopinath explores near-death experiences as participants share survival, regrets and lessons from dangerous moments. Their experiences inspire them to find renewed purpose in life.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: As the competition intensifies, contestants race towards the finale while judges identify mistakes and mark corrections. With stakes rising, contestants strive to prove themselves.
